title: Felix and the Cipher
author: Rosalind Voss
blurb: Jonah Yarrow, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
